26 Which statement is an example of the diffraction of light?
A
the addition of the amplitudes of two beams of light which are in phase
B
the change in direction of a beam of light when passing from air into water
C
the separation of a beam of white light into a spectrum of colours using a prism
D
the spreading of a beam of light as it passes through a small hole

hints: Carefully read the question stem and identify the given physical quantities for 9702_s16_12_q26.
Apply the relevant physical formula or conservation principle connecting these quantities.
Calculate or deduce the final result and match with the correct option.
walkthrough: Examine the physical scenario described in the question.
Apply the foundational equations governing this topic to evaluate the options.
The correct deduction leads directly to option D.
